## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest`, `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy src` pass locally
- [ ] Public API changes have docstrings and are documented in the README or `docs/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under *Unreleased* (if users would notice the change)
